summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amendment under Rule 424(b)(5) solely to correct pricing terms in a securities purchase agreement with High West Partners LLC for the sale of up to US$30,000,000 of ordinary shares plus US$300,000 in commitment shares. The purchase price is formula-based. HW acts as an underwriter. This is a routine at-the-market offering registration amendment, not a special situation. No tender, acquisition, activist, restructuring, or termination exists. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown adjustment. Risk-arb angle: none; this is capital-raising, not a special event.
